about: English specs and build status of the more-batch decisions (cbmagic_more.tpa), by decision-page row. Same format as docs/build-specs.json.

parts.spec: Haste and Slow cancel each other across spells and items as in SCS (haste_cancels_slow.tpa): Haste on a slowed target displays 'Slow cancelled by Haste', removes the Slow (sectype cbm_Slow), and does not start Haste or its fatigue; Slow on a hasted target displays 'Haste cancelled by Slow', removes the Haste (sectype cbm_Haste), and does not start Slow. Haste stays vanilla in every other way (bonus, duration, fatigue).

Improved Haste (SPWI613 and scroll SCRL7Q) becomes the party buff of Spell Revisions, built cleanly without opcode 16 so there is no second speed clock: keeps all 9 ability headers (min_level 1, 13..20), Area target (4), range 30, casting time 6, party-friendly 15-ft radius projectile 158 (INAREAPA), duration 1 turn (60s), dispellable (sectype 13 NON-COMBAT, resist_dispel 3), granting +6 movement rate (opcode 176), +1 APR (opcode 1), +2 THAC0 (opcode 54), +2 AC (opcode 0), +2 Saving Throws vs. Breath (opcode 36), curing any active Slow (opcode 221 cbm_Slow + opcode 240 icon 41), granting immunity to Slow for 60s (opcode 101 p2=40, opcode 169 p2=41, opcode 267 strings, opcode 206 against Slow spells, and HASTE_IMMUNITY splstate blocking extracted Slow subspells), and preventing stacking with Haste and itself.

Stays vanilla except it loses Aura Cleansing: ability target is changed from 7 (Caster, instant, ignore aura and casting time) to 5 (Caster, normal spell action) so casting Nahal's Reckless Dweomer obeys the normal 1-spell-per-round aura timer, and any explicit opcode 188 (Cleanse Aura) effect is removed.

Dispelling Screen replaces Spell Immunity (SPWI510) on Wizard level 5 (and its scroll SCRL6S.ITM): lasts 5 turns (300 seconds), protects the caster and allies in a 15-ft party-only area (projectile 158 INAREAPA) against one Dispel/Remove Magic (opcode 58) or one Breach (SPWI513, split into SPWI513B payload and SPWI513C secondary-type removal), and is removed by Pierce Shield (SPWI805) and Spellstrike (SPWI903) without absorbing them. Spell Immunity's school-selection menu is removed and its 8 school subspells (SPWI590..SPWI597) redirect to SPWI510 so existing scripts and creatures cast Dispelling Screen.

Base-game priest Protection from Fire (SPPR306, level 3) and Protection from Lightning (SPPR407, level 4) stay at their vanilla levels; two new priest spells for clerics and druids are added via ADD_SPELL: Protection From Cold on level 3 (CLERIC_CBMAGIC_PROTECTION_FROM_COLD, built like SPPR306 with +100% normal cold resistance op 28 and +80% magical cold resistance op 85 for 3 rounds + 1 round/level across levels 1-20, icons SPWI320C/SPWI320B, portrait icon 25, visual ICrmpari) and Protection From Acid on level 4 (CLERIC_CBMAGIC_PROTECTION_FROM_ACID, built like SPPR407 with 100% acid resistance op 27 p2=1 for 5 rounds/level across levels 1 and 8-18, icons SPWI517C/SPWI517B, portrait icon 24, visual ICrmpari).
